_README: Playgama Bridge config. This is authored by US, not generated by their dashboard — the SDK simply fetches ./playgama-bridge-config.json on init. Fields below are the ones that matter for this game; everything else stays at SDK defaults.
_why_initialInterstitialDelay: The SDK's own default is 60s, 30s or 180s depending on platform, during which it REFUSES every interstitial. Certification runs are far shorter than that, which is why the first run reported 'no advertising is implemented'. 5s keeps an ad off the very first seconds of play while staying reachable.
_why_minimumDelay: The game already spaces its own ad breaks 90s apart (adBreak in main.js). 60 here means the SDK never becomes the tighter of the two gates by surprise.
